name: onyx-evals-study
description: An eval study of Onyx (self-hosted RAG) answering Victorian rental-law questions: which law version it uses, and a fix.

scripts.cases: python3 scripts/make-rental-cases.py && npm run build && node dist/src/cases.js
scripts.seed: npm run build && EVAL_CORPUS=vic-rentals-baseline node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/seed.js
scripts.eval:rentals: npm run build && EVAL_CORPUS=vic-rentals-baseline REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000 promptfoo eval --no-cache -c promptfooconfig.rentals.yaml
scripts.eval:rentals:undated: npm run build && EVAL_CORPUS=vic-rentals-baseline REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000 promptfoo eval --no-cache -c promptfooconfig.rentals.yaml --tests datasets/vic-rentals-undated.yaml
scripts.eval:rentals:heldout: npm run build && EVAL_CORPUS=vic-rentals-baseline REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000 promptfoo eval --no-cache -c promptfooconfig.rentals.yaml --tests datasets/vic-rentals-heldout.yaml
scripts.eval:rentals:heldout-undated: npm run build && EVAL_CORPUS=vic-rentals-baseline REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000 promptfoo eval --no-cache -c promptfooconfig.rentals.yaml --tests datasets/vic-rentals-heldout-undated.yaml
scripts.eval:rentals:asof: npm run build && EVAL_CORPUS=vic-rentals-baseline REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000 promptfoo eval --no-cache -c promptfooconfig.rentals-asof.yaml
scripts.eval:rentals:oracle: npm run build && EVAL_CORPUS=vic-rentals-baseline REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000 promptfoo eval --no-cache -c promptfooconfig.rentals-oracle.yaml
scripts.regrade: npm run build && promptfoo eval --no-cache -c promptfooconfig.regrade.yaml
scripts.goldcheck: npm run build && promptfoo eval --no-cache -c promptfooconfig.goldcheck.yaml
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/tests/cases.test.js dist/tests/corpus.test.js
scripts.test:live: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/tests/setup-idempotency.test.js dist/tests/prompt-cleanliness.test.js
